title: Houthis claim attack on Riyadh financial district, Aramco tower damaged
summary: Yemen's Houthis on Sunday claimed an attack on the financial district of the Saudi capital Riyadh, with eyewitnesses saying they saw damage to a skyscraper belonging to oil giant Aramco.
